title.en: An Act Authorizing the Remission of Certain Obligations of the Mountain Province With the Philippine Health Service.

text.en:
The remission of the indebtedness in the amount of twenty thousand and three hundred
eighty-one pesos and seventy-two centavos of the Mountain Province with the Philippine Health Service on
account of salaries paid up to December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-one, by that Service to its
officers and employees assigned to that province is hereby authorized.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1932.
